name: Lee Sang-hee
bio: Lee Sang-hee (October 8, 1983), born Lee Na-ri, is a South Korean actress. She first became known for her role in the film End of Winter (2014). She later rose to prominence and gained recognition for her role in the film Our Love Story (2016). She also appeared in television series such as Children of the 20th Century (2017) and One Spring Night (2019).
